Warnings
Do not use in children under 12 years unless directed by a doctor.
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms last up to 2 weeks
to 2 weeks symptoms recur
Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, call a Poison Control Centre or doctor immediately, even
if you have no signs or symptoms.

Directions ●Adults and children 12 years and older: take 1 softgel as needed after meals and at
bedtime ●do not take more than 3 softgels in 24 hours
